_comment: Canonical versions for vendored third-party packages. PES stores names and versions, never the binaries — a standards repo cloned constantly should not carry 300MB of xcframeworks. scripts/update.sh --check compares each app's App/Packages/<Name>/.vendor-version against this and reports drift. Contents are never copied: apps deliberately vendor different product subsets (ABCLearning excludes Analytics for the Kids Category), and overwriting that would be an App Store compliance problem.

FirebaseKit.notes: Vendored from the official Firebase.zip manual-integration build. Product subset differs per app on purpose.
